title: Integrated Characterization of AP-2delta Reveals Distinct Regulatory Architecture in Lung Adenocarcinoma and Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
authors: Kolat, Damian; Kruczkowska, Weronika; Kaluzinska-Kolat, Zaneta; Zemnou, Cromwel Tepap; Kciuk, Mateusz; Zhao, Lin-Yong; Kontek, Renata; Pluciennik, Elzbieta
one_liner_zh: 该文整合表征AP-2delta转录因子在肺癌亚型中的调控架构，含AlphaFold结构口袋分析，但以表达与临床组学为主，缺乏TF-DNA结合位点预测或互作机制建模，方法可迁移但深度不足。
abstract: Background/Objectives: AP-2delta, encoded by TFAP2D, is one of the least characterized members of the AP-2 transcription factor family, although available evidence suggests biologically relevant roles in lung cancer that have not yet been thoroughly examined. The aim of the present study was to provide an integrated characterization of AP-2delta/TFAP2D in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC). Methods: LUAD and LUSC data were obtained from The Cancer Genome Atlas. The analysis comprised the expression profiling of AP-2delta target genes, survival-guided TFAP2D stratification, clinical profiling, differential expression and intersection analyses, methylation-derived chromatin compartment profiling, TFAP2D-associated cofactor rewiring, and genome-wide enrichment of AP-2delta targets. In parallel, pocket prioritization was performed using an AlphaFold model of AP-2delta with cross-tool consensus mapping. Results: TFAP2D stratification delineated biologically-distinct states in both histological subtypes (LUAD and LUSC). AP-2delta target genes showed subtype-specific expression patterns and functional organization. The consistent survival association was observed for progression-free interval rather than uniformly across all endpoints. Clinical profiling was more closely associated with molecular subtype composition than broad clinicopathological differences. Differential expression analyses identified both shared and histology-dependent programs associated with TFAP2D. In the chromatin-compartment analysis, LUSC showed a broader and more coherent footprint, whereas LUAD displayed more selective cofactor rewiring. Structure-based analysis prioritized a small set of reproducible candidate pockets concentrated within ordered regions of the TF_AP-2 domain. Conclusions: AP-2delta marks biologically meaningful but histologically non-uniform regulatory states in lung cancer. These findings provide an integrated framework for understanding TFAP2D-dependent regulation in LUAD and LUSC, highlighting AP-2delta as a candidate for future mechanistic and translational investigation.
abstract_zh: 背景/目标：AP-2delta，由TFAP2D编码，是AP-2转录因子家族中特征化程度最低的成员之一，尽管现有证据提示其在肺癌中具有生物学相关作用，但尚未得到深入探究。本研究旨在对肺腺癌（LUAD）和肺鳞状细胞癌（LUSC）中的AP-2delta/TFAP2D进行整合性表征。方法：LUAD和LUSC数据获取自癌症基因组图谱（The Cancer Genome Atlas）。分析包括AP-2delta靶基因的表达谱分析、基于生存的TFAP2D分层、临床特征分析、差异表达及交集分析、甲基化衍生的染色质区室分析、TFAP2D相关辅因子重连，以及AP-2delta靶点的全基因组富集分析。同时，利用AP-2delta的AlphaFold模型结合跨工具共识映射进行口袋优先级排序。结果：TFAP2D分层在两种组织学亚型（LUAD和LUSC）中描绘出生物学上不同的状态。AP-2delta靶基因表现出亚型特异性表达模式和功能组织。一致的生存关联在无进展间期观察到，而非在所有终点中均匀出现。临床特征分析与分子亚型组成的关联比广泛的临床病理学差异更为密切。差异表达分析识别出与TFAP2D相关的共享程序和组学依赖性程序。在染色质区室分析中，LUSC显示出更广泛且更连贯的足迹，而LUAD则表现出更选择性的辅因子重连。基于结构的分析优先排序出一小组可重复的候选口袋，集中在TF_AP-2结构域的有序区域内。结论：AP-2delta在肺癌中标记出具有生物学意义但组织学上非均匀的调控状态。这些发现为理解LUAD和LUSC中TFAP2D依赖性调控提供了整合框架，并强调AP-2delta作为未来机制和转化研究的候选靶点。
